name: 3D Light PAD
aliases: volumetric three-dimensional digital light photoactivatable dye display
definition: A volumetric 3D display that uses photoactivatable molecules and digital light processing (DLP) to generate structured light in three dimensions by simultaneously activating and exciting fluorophores in a spatial pattern defined by DLP.
summary: 3D Light PAD is a volumetric display using DLP projectors and photoactivatable dyes to generate simultaneous 3D fluorescent voxels, avoiding sequential activation and expensive high-energy beams.
